message:
Thanks, Spencer. In some ways, I'm thinking your [Nine Interviews](http://9interviews.com/) project could be a useful preventative heuristic, kind of like the question about which Beatle one identifies most with -- only you'd ask potential MLAers, "Which of the nine do you identify most with" and then use that answer to say: OK, here's what NOT to do in the interview/campus visit.

(Behavior I'd most want to avoid: Mr. Peanut.)
